scope: Concrete reachable consumers, not a blanket assertion that every enum_map default is a bug. These changes are NOT in TrackKind production patch.

rows.trigger: Authorized AUDIO/VIDEO request with encryption99 or-1; permission/type valid
rows.rust_chain: signal/params.rs444 -> encryption_from_proto defaults None -> core build_track_info req.encryption -> convert.TrackInfo0 and published_spec encrypted=(encryption!=None) false
rows.source_chain: fixed participant.go3147-3153 copies req.Encryption unchanged; mediatrackreceiver.go510-511 IsEncrypted is Encryption!=NONE; subscribedtrack.go129 and downtrack.go471 consume that flag
rows.observable: TrackPublished.encryption loses numeric value and the produced PublishedTrackSpec.encrypted flag becomes false. Whether the current Rust media engine actually consumes that flag requires a separate native audit; no payload decryption or plaintext-exposure claim is made.
rows.next_gate: Original Go and old/candidate positive WS TrackPublished numeric encryption; old API PublishedTrackSpec.encrypted assertion; genuine encrypted native codec/RED/silence/transceiver-reuse consumer separately.

rows.rust_chain: twirp/room_service.rs614 -> data_kind_from_proto defaults Reliable -> manager sends reliable delivery class; original packet raw enum may still be serialized, which does not fix channel selection
rows.source_chain: roommanager.go977-994 copies req.Kind; room.go843/BroadcastDataPacketForRoom preserves raw kind; participant.go4176+ non-RELIABLE branch requires ACTIVE and bypasses reliable joining cache; transport.go1503-1520 routes kind!=RELIABLE to lossyDC

rows.next_gate: Actual original public SendData and unmodified SDK/data-channel label observation, plus old API joining-vs-active delivery effect. No success claim from HTTP200 alone.

rows.next_gate: Actual Go positive AUDIO TrackPublished features, actual update/replayed TrackInfo, old public actor metadata comparison retaining unknown values and source dedup order.

rows.source_chain: participant.go3119-3135 clones and numerically sorts raw layer qualities; no early rejection. subscribedtrack.go353-364 preserves raw quality; videolayerutils.go448-466 delegates multilayer unknown quality to VideoQualityToSpatialLayer281-349 default InvalidLayerSpatial

rows.field: TrackInfo.packet_trailer_features (related omitted field, not enum_map default)

rows.rust_chain: neutral AddTrack/TrackInfo have no packet-trailer field; positive convert/models.rs uses ..Default::default, so output list empty. Cached rejected request echo is correct and does not certify positive publication.

rows.next_gate: Actual source positive TrackPublished features before native packet-trailer parsing and forwarding qualification.

not_claimed_as_bugs: Unknown client Leave.reason is intentionally mapped to CLIENT_INITIATED by fixed signalhandler.go87-101; Rust client_leave_reason whitelist matches that source fallback.

ParticipantState/ConnectionQuality/StreamState/RoomEndReason/SubscriptionError roundtrip defaults need a concrete reachable external producer before promotion to a public functional finding. Enum-map presence alone is insufficient.
